entities.summary: Kira Aundrea Lewis Jr. is an American professional basketball player for the Wisconsin Herd of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the Alabama Crimson Tide and was drafted by the New Orleans Pelicans in the first round of the 2020 NBA draft.
